method: float64 GLB TRS FK with normalized shortest-arc SLERP; exact source/profile identities fixed. Not bit-identical to Blender float32; profile values are separately authoritative.

derivation.retarget_rotation: For joint i: Rt_i(t)=Ds_i(t)*Bt_i, where Ds_i(t)=Rs_i(t)*inverse(Bs_i). Target local translations and scales retain their own rest values.
derivation.position: For a parent-to-child edge, its translated contribution is A_parent(t)*local_translation_child. Equal source/target world rotations do not make unequal rest segment vectors cancel.
derivation.assumptions: The idle root/hip are fixed, non-root local translations/scales are fixed, and source and target use the same prepared-axis rotation. Observed float32 retarget quantization is reported as prediction residual, not removed.

production_budget.decision: Root accepted morphology-aware natural FK on2026-11-16; source-only near-fixed grip is not a universal target end-effector lock.
production_budget.basis: 2mm is under0.3percent of the measured0.720676m blade and below the approximately4.5-5mm head-breathing motion. It is an authoring budget, not floating-point or collision tolerance.
production_budget.unchanged_gates: No change to root/foot1e-6 or exact closed-loop checks. Mount and bone fixtures are evaluated independently of the2mm budget.

conclusion.classification: Expected FK consequence of rotation-only world-rest retarget with preserved target lengths/rest vectors; source fixed wrist is not a target end-effector constraint.
conclusion.drift_cause_scope: Temporal hand-to-blade marker matrices are constant and lengths are preserved; varying mount/scale does not cause the measured drift. Static ergonomic grip/mesh clearance is not assessed by these matrix checks.
conclusion.original_commitment_scope: The source RHand/dao was held near fixed. A universal10micrometre target lock was not established by the rotation-transfer contract.
conclusion.recommendation: Root selected existing morphology-aware FK with2mm target micromotion authoring budget; retain source-only near-fixed grip, exact loop and original root/foot checks. No production/test file is changed by this diagnosis.

options.name: Preserve morphology-aware natural FK
options.implementation: Keep current retarget. Root may define verification around unchanged bone/knife lengths, constant mount, closed loop, temporal world-rest rotation transfer, and an independently predicted target FK trajectory. Keep source near-fixed grip as a source assertion only.
options.tradeoff: No new deformation or helper/IK changes. Indigo/veteran retain measured0.397/1.051mm natural wrist translation, about0.055/0.146percent of blade length. A10micrometre target-position assertion would need an explicitly different contract, not a larger unexplained epsilon.

options.name: Add explicit target end-effector constraint
options.implementation: At existing idle keys solve a two-bone right-arm IK using the target actual lengths, guard-time wrist anchor plus scaled source wrist displacement, source-transferred hand orientation, and a continuous source-derived elbow pole. Keep shoulder/chest breathing, all original key times, rest/IBM/Grip/fingers, and deterministic closed endpoints. Reconcile elbow/twist helper support using real weights; regenerate/review all three targets.
options.tradeoff: Produces designed steady hands across morphologies without stretch or copied endpoint frames, but changes target arm curves and needs reachability, pole continuity, helper deformation, clearance and canonical-boundary review. It is a new constraint absent from the present rotation-only transfer, not a numerical bug patch.
